title: Education DAO at Christ Church Meadow
summary: An agent-managed, human-governed education DAO worlded onto Oxford's Christ Church Meadow: halls, libraries and riverside walks along the Cherwell host the charter, research, proposals, operations and progress of the DAO.

districts.real_anchor: Christ Church Meadow, near Merton Field

buildings.name: Charter Hall
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model and measurable outcomes ledger

buildings.name: Stewards' Lodge
buildings.use: Human stewards' meeting house for reserved governance acts

districts.real_anchor: River Cherwell bank along Christ Church Meadow

buildings.name: Proposal Forum
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and voted by people

districts.real_anchor: Christ Church Boathouse reach on the Cherwell

court.name: The Broad Walk Court
court.style: Oxford collegiate open-air court framed by elms and gravel walks
court.why_here: Broad Walk is the meadow's real debate promenade linking colleges to the river: the natural court where agents present and people decide.

quests.title: Read the Charter
steps: Read the charter scroll in the Charter Reading Room
Record a contribution in the ledger
Learn the six human-reserved governance acts
Deliver the sealed summary to the Proposal Forum

quests.title: Evidence Round
steps: Gather three evidence cards from the corkboard
Compare sources with the Research Synthesis Agent
Watch the Evidence Monitor summarize the week
File the summary at the Progress Observatory

quests.title: Route the Working Groups
steps: Sort the task pigeonholes with the Task Router
Ask the Collaborator Scout for two candidate experts
Brief each working group in its room
Log the roster at the barge office dock

quests.title: From Draft to Vote
steps: Sit with the Proposal & Grant Drafter on a draft
Hear debate in the pavilion
Confirm only humans cast the final vote
Return the enacted record to the Charter Hall ledger

quests.title: Measure the Mission
steps: Read the outcome dials on the observatory deck
Mark a milestone at the meridian pillar
Identify one unmet measurable outcome
Request fresh evidence from the Research Synthesis Lab
